articles.title: A Tiny X-ray Telescope Could Finally Map the Moon's Secret Chemistry!
articles.summary: Imagine a camera so small it weighs less than a big dog, yet it could map the entire Moon! Scientists tested a mini X-ray telescope that might reveal what the Moon is made of—all in just two years.

articles.title: A Feather Duster Became a Mom for Two Orphaned Baby Turkeys!
articles.summary: What do you do when two tiny turkey chicks lose their mom? At a wildlife center, staff gave them a feather duster to snuggle under—and it worked! The chicks calmed down and started eating more.

articles.title: Hidden Black Hole Pairs Could Flash Like Cosmic Lighthouses!
articles.summary: Two giant black holes circling each other might act like a cosmic magnifying glass, making stars behind them flash brightly over and over. Scientists think this could help us find these hidden pairs in space.
